svg.text: Route: /admin/categories · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Admin only. Uses the manuscript's category fields: name (unique, whatever the capitals), icon (one emoji), sort order and “new” (a NEW badge on the kiosk's category tile). Add category
opens the form above; Edit turns a row into the same form.
• ↑ / ↓ change the kiosk rail's order (PUT /api/categories/order). Only an empty category can be deleted, after “Yes, delete” (last row); one with products says “… still has N products.
Move them to another category on the Products page first.”
• Every change is sent to open kiosks (categories:changed), which reload their category rail at once.

g.text: The order below is the order of the kiosk's category rail. Kiosks update as soon as you save.
One emoji, shown on the kiosk's category tile. On Windows, press Win + . to pick one.
